blocks.en: Three passions, simple but overwhelmingly strong, have governed my life: the longing for love, the search for knowledge, and unbearable pity for the suffering of mankind. These passions, like great winds, have blown me hither and thither, in a wayward course, over a deep ocean of anguish, reaching to the very verge of despair.
blocks.zh: 三种简单却无比强烈的激情支配着我的生活: 对爱的渴望，对知识的追求，对人类苦难的难以忍受的怜悯。这些激情，像大风一样，在一个任性的过程中，在一个痛苦的深海中，把我吹来吹去，到达绝望的边缘。

blocks.en: I have sought love, first, because it brings ecstasy - ecstasy so great that I would often have sacrificed all the rest of life for a few hours of this joy. I have sought it, next, because it relieves loneliness- that terrible loneliness In which one shivering consciousness looks over the rim of the world into the cold unfathomable lifeless abyss. I have sought it, finally, because in the union of love I have seen, in a mystic miniature, the prefiguring vision of the heaven that saints and poets have imagined. This is what I sought, and though it might seem too good for human life, this is what - at last - I have found.
blocks.zh: 我寻找爱，首先，因为它带来狂喜 -- 狂喜如此之大，以至于我常常会为了这几个小时的快乐而牺牲余生。接下来，我寻求它，因为它减轻了孤独-一种可怕的孤独，在这种孤独中，一个发抖的意识将世界的边缘注视着寒冷而深不可测的无生命深渊。我终于找到了它，因为在爱的结合中，我以神秘的缩影看到了圣人和诗人所想象的天堂的预兆。这就是我所寻求的，尽管它似乎对人类生活来说太好了，但这就是我最终找到的。

blocks.en: With equal passion I have sought knowledge. I have wished to understand the hearts of men. I have wished to know why the stars shine. And I have tried to apprehend the Pythagorean power by which number holds sway above the flux. A little of this, but not much, I have achieved.
blocks.zh: 我同样满怀热情地追求知识。我想了解男人的心。我想知道为什么星星会发光。我试图理解毕达哥拉斯的力量，通过这种力量，数字可以控制在通量之上。我做到了一点，但不多。

blocks.en: Love and knowledge, so far as they were possible, led upward toward the heavens. But always pity brought me back to earth. Echoes of cries of pain reverberate in my heart. Children in famine, victims tortured by oppressors, helpless old people a hated burden to their sons, and the whole world of loneliness, poverty, and pain make a mockery of what human life should be. I long to alleviate the evil, but I cannot, and I too suffer.
blocks.zh: 爱和知识，只要有可能，就向上通向天堂。但总是怜悯带我回到地球。痛苦的哭声回荡在我的心中。饥荒中的儿童，被压迫者折磨的受害者，无助的老人是他们儿子讨厌的负担，整个孤独、贫穷和痛苦的世界都在嘲弄人类的生活。我渴望减轻邪恶，但我不能，我也受苦。
blocks.translation_method: machine draft with validated paragraph alignment

blocks.en: This has been my life. I have found it worth living, and would gladly live it again if the chance were offered me.
blocks.zh: 这就是我的生活.我发现它值得活下去，如果有机会，我很乐意再活一次。
